doc:
If `H ≤ K`, then `G/H ≃ G/K × K/H` constructively, using the provided right inverse
of the quotient map `G → G/K`. The classical version is `Subgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE`.
statement:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Group α] →
    {s t : Subgroup α} →
      s ≤ t → (f : α ⧸ t → α) → Function.RightInverse f QuotientGroup.mk → α ⧸ s ≃ (α ⧸ t) × ↥t ⧸ s.subgroupOf t

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {s t : AddSubgroup α} (h_le : s ≤ t) (f : α ⧸ t → α)
  (hf : Function.RightInverse f QuotientAddGroup.mk) (a : α ⧸ s),
  (AddSubgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE' h_le f hf) a =
    (Quotient.map' id ⋯ a, Quotient.map' (fun g => ⟨-f (Quotient.mk'' g) + g, ⋯⟩) ⋯ a)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {s t : AddSubgroup α} (h_le : s ≤ t) (f : α ⧸ t → α)
  (hf : Function.RightInverse f QuotientAddGroup.mk) (a : (α ⧸ t) × ↥t ⧸ s.addSubgroupOf t),
  (AddSubgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE' h_le f hf).symm a = Quotient.map' (fun b => f a.1 + ↑b) ⋯ a.2

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] {s t : Subgroup α} (h_le : s ≤ t) (f : α ⧸ t → α)
  (hf : Function.RightInverse f QuotientGroup.mk) (a : α ⧸ s),
  (Subgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE' h_le f hf) a =
    (Quotient.map' id ⋯ a, Quotient.map' (fun g => ⟨(f (Quotient.mk'' g))⁻¹ * g, ⋯⟩) ⋯ a)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {ι : Type u_2} (f : ι → AddSubgroup α) (g : α) (i : ι),
  (AddSubgroup.quotientiInfEmbedding f) (↑g) i = ↑g

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] {ι : Type u_2} (f : ι → Subgroup α) (g : α) (i : ι),
  (Subgroup.quotientiInfEmbedding f) (↑g) i = ↑g

doc: An equivalence between any non-empty fiber of a `MonoidHom` and its kernel.
statement:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Group α] → {H : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : Group H] → (f : α →* H) → (a : α) → ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a}) ≃ ↥f.ker

doc: An equivalence between any non-empty fiber of an `AddMonoidHom` and its kernel.
statement:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : AddGroup α] → {H : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : AddGroup H] → (f : α →+ H) → (a : α) → ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a}) ≃ ↥f.ker

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddGroup H] (f : α →+ H) (a : α) (g : ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a})),
  ↑((f.fiberEquivKer a) g) = -a + ↑g

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group H] (f : α →* H) (a : α) (g : ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a})),
  ↑((f.fiberEquivKer a) g) = a⁻¹ * ↑g

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddGroup H] (f : α →+ H) (a : α) (g : ↥f.ker),
  ↑((f.fiberEquivKer a).symm g) = a + ↑g

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group H] (f : α →* H) (a : α) (g : ↥f.ker),
  ↑((f.fiberEquivKer a).symm g) = a * ↑g

    {H : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : Group H] → {f : α →* H} → Function.Surjective ⇑f → (h : H) → ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {h}) ≃ ↥f.ker

doc: An equivalence between any two non-empty fibers of a `MonoidHom`.
statement:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Group α] → {H : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : Group H] → (f : α →* H) → (a b : α) → ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a}) ≃ ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f b})

doc: An equivalence between any two non-empty fibers of an `AddMonoidHom`.
statement:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : AddGroup α] →
    {H : Type u_2} → [inst_1 : AddGroup H] → (f : α →+ H) → (a b : α) → ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a}) ≃ ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f b})

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group H] (f : α →* H) (a b : α) (g : ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a})),
  ↑((f.fiberEquiv a b) g) = b * (a⁻¹ * ↑g)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddGroup H] (f : α →+ H) (a b : α) (g : ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f a})),
  ↑((f.fiberEquiv a b) g) = b + (-a + ↑g)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddGroup H] (f : α →+ H) (a b : α) (g : ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f b})),
  ↑((f.fiberEquiv a b).symm g) = a + (-b + ↑g)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] {H : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group H] (f : α →* H) (a b : α) (g : ↑(⇑f ⁻¹' {f b})),
  ↑((f.fiberEquiv a b).symm g) = a * (b⁻¹ * ↑g)

doc:
If `s` is a subgroup of the group `α`, and `t` is a subset of `α ⧸ s`, then there is a

statement: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : Group α] → (s : Subgroup α) → (t : Set (α ⧸ s)) → ↑(QuotientGroup.mk ⁻¹' t) ≃ ↥s × ↑t

doc:
If `s` is a subgroup of the additive group `α`, and `t` is a subset of `α ⧸ s`, then

statement: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : AddGroup α] → (s : AddSubgroup α) → (t : Set (α ⧸ s)) → ↑(QuotientAddGroup.mk ⁻¹' t) ≃ ↥s × ↑t

doc: A group is made up of a disjoint union of cosets of a subgroup.
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Group α] (H : Subgroup α), Set.univ = ⋃ x, Quotient.out x • ↑H

statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] (H : AddSubgroup α), Set.univ = ⋃ x, Quotient.out x +ᵥ ↑H
